positioning.fde: Applied AI Solutions Engineer · Forward-Deployed Delivery

summaries.ai: Applied AI Solutions Engineer who designs and ships production software end to end — TypeScript/React web applications, retrieval-grounded AI assistants, and agentic engineering workflows with independent review loops. Owner of a company website rebuild and an ERP/CRM used daily by 10 staff. Two products live in production.
summaries.fde: Forward-deployed engineer who ships software inside the customer's reality — on-site discovery, design under real-world constraints, rollout and adoption. Embedded with operators from retail counters to factory gates: offline-first systems for unreliable networks, and an ERP/CRM that replaced spreadsheets for 10 daily staff.

bullets: Own the company web platform and internal ERP/CRM end to end — architecture, Postgres schema and row-level security, UI, deployment — for a system 10 staff run daily.
Replaced spreadsheet-run operations with priority-based ticket triage (P1–P5), live dashboards and real-time reporting — record errors down, urgent jobs first.

Shipping a Next.js 16 + TypeScript website rebuild: 96-model catalogue, retrieval-grounded assistant (Gemini 2.0 Flash / GPT-4o-mini) that answers from the knowledge base and captures leads; in development with hosting in progress.
Run an agentic build pipeline — multi-model generation with an independent review agent on a different model family auditing every diff before merge.
Delivered DataFlow Pro, a BI platform unifying revenue, compliance risk and operational KPIs into one real-time dashboard (Power BI, SQL, Python).
Saved leadership 15–20 hours/month of manual data processing and reporting.
Accelerated delivery with AI-assisted SQL refactoring (Claude) and pipeline orchestration (OpenCode).
Digitised inventory-tracking and AMC-management workflows into a Python/MySQL system with HTML forms and Google Suite, replacing paper processes.
Cut administrative turnaround time and improved reporting accuracy for the operations team.
